mapper.sql: release_id, eval_type, version_name, snapshot_version_id, content_hash, case_count, status, review_comment, created_by, reviewed_by, created_at_ms, reviewed_at_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_eval_dataset_release (release_id, eval_type, version_name, snapshot_version_id, content_hash, case_count, status, review_comment, created_by, reviewed_by, created_at_ms, reviewed_at_ms) VALUES (#{releaseId}, #{evalType}, #{versionName}, #{snapshotVersionId}, #{contentHash}, #{caseCount}, #{status}, #{reviewComment}, #{createdBy}, #{reviewedBy}, #{createdAtMs}, #{reviewedAtMs})
mapper.update: UPDATE cw_eval_dataset_release SET status = #{targetStatus}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at_ms = #{reviewedAtMs} WHERE release_id = #{releaseId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
